field.name: questionSetId
field.comment: The ID of the set of questions displayed by the block, which is the questionSetId of the rows of btFormQuestions

field.name: surveyName
field.comment: The title displayed above the questions

field.name: submitText
field.comment: The text of the button that submits the form

field.name: thankyouMsg
field.comment: The text displayed once the form has been submitted (used if redirectCID is 0)

field.name: notifyMeOnSubmission
field.comment: true: an email is sent to the recipientEmail addresses when the form is submitted; false: no email is sent

field.name: recipientEmail
field.comment: The email addresses notified when the form is submitted, separated by commas (used if notifyMeOnSubmission is true)

field.name: displayCaptcha
field.comment: true: the visitors must solve a captcha before submitting the form; false: they don't

field.name: redirectCID
field.comment: The ID of the page the visitors are sent to once the form has been submitted (0 or NULL: thankyouMsg is displayed instead)

field.name: addFilesToSet
field.comment: The ID of the file set that the files uploaded with the form are added to (0 or NULL: none)

field.name: qID
field.comment: The ID of this version of the question: editing a question adds a new row instead of changing the current one

field.name: msqID
field.comment: The ID shared by every version of the question, which is what the answers refer to

field.name: questionSetId
field.comment: The ID of the set of questions the question belongs to

field.name: question
field.comment: The text of the question, displayed above its input

field.name: inputType
field.comment: What the visitors answer with: field, text, email, telephone, url, select, radios, checkboxlist, date, datetime or fileupload

field.name: options
field.comment: The choices of a select, radios or checkboxlist question, separated by %%; for an email question, the PHP serialization of its send_notification_from flag

field.name: position
field.comment: The position of the question in the set, starting from zero

field.name: width
field.comment: How many columns wide the input of a text question is, between 20 and 500 (used if inputType is text)

field.name: height
field.comment: How many rows tall the input of a text question is, between 1 and 100 (used if inputType is text)

field.name: defaultDate
field.comment: The date offered by default (used if inputType is date or datetime)

field.name: required
field.comment: true: the visitors must answer the question; false: they can leave it empty

field.name: asID
field.comment: The ID of the submitted form

field.name: questionSetId
field.comment: The ID of the set of questions that was answered

field.name: created
field.comment: When the form was submitted

field.name: uID
field.comment: The ID of the user that submitted the form (0 or NULL: nobody was logged in)

field.name: aID
field.comment: The ID of the answer

field.name: asID
field.comment: The ID of the submitted form holding the answer

field.name: msqID
field.comment: The ID shared by every version of the question that was answered

field.name: answer
field.comment: The answer, as the visitor gave it, cut to 255 characters (a fileupload question stores the ID of the file here)

field.name: answerLong
field.comment: The whole answer of a text question, which is too long for the answer field
